description: A fast castle with Grand Fulani Corral build to pump Sofas and Archers. This build bases its economy heavily on passive income, so securing these passive income sources is vital to the succes of this playstyle.
name: S5 Cow Boom into Sofa/Archer
author: Valdemar1902

notes: When 150@https://age4builder.com/img/resourcewoodicon.webp@ take all 5@https://age4builder.com/img/villagerMA.png@</img> from straggler tree to @https://age4builder.com/img/sheep.png@</img>

@https://age4builder.com/img/age2dark.webp@ 5@https://age4builder.com/img/villagerMA.png@</img> goes to @https://age4builder.com/img/goldminingcamp.png@</img>@https://age4builder.com/img/resourcegoldicon.png@</img>. Build @https://age4builder.com/img/lumbercamp.png@</img> when done with straggler trees. Build a @building_malians/cattle-ranch-2.png@</img>
@resource/cattle.png@</img>  should be 6 with a 4x4 tile space for the @landmark_malians/grand-fulani-corral-2.png@</img> Landmark. + Now you should start building a 2nd

Keep adding more production and build up a big army mainly of @unit_malians/sofa-2.webp@  and @https://age4builder.com/img/archer2.png@</img>. Consider setting up trade now as well, and produce siege for pushing. Don't forget @https://age4builder.com/img/blacksmith.png@</img>As usual with greedy builds like this, remember to make units in feudal for defending, if your opponent looks to try and deal damage early on.

5 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and chop 150 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ then to @resource/resource_food.webp@. 1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to @building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@ and build 7 @building_economy/house.webp@

@resource/rally.webp@1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to a 2nd @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and chop an additional 25 @resource/resource_wood.webp@. Then @resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_food.webp@
Gather 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ from @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ then switch to @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@. @resource/rally.webp@ until 10 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@
When you have 2 donsos and 2 javs then go and build 2nd @building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@
Take 5 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ and go on @resource/deer.webp@ and build a @building_malians/toll-outpost-1.webp@
Now you start cow booming and continue to make units. Minimum 12 cows b4 age 3. Don't be afraid to push opponent if they go castle.
Full @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ @unit_malians/sofa-2.webp@. Take @resource/relics.webp@ and play the game out with heavy raiding and expansion.
Send 5x @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ from @landmark_malians/mansa-quarry-2.png@ to build 1x @building_economy/mining-camp.png@ and then farm @resource/resource_gold.png@
*If opponent is being aggressive, build counter units*

description: From Grand Finals of EGC Masters Summer
name: LoueMTs Sofa Archer Style
author: Valdemar1902

notes: 5 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and chop 150 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ then to @resource/resource_food.webp@. 1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to @building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@ and build 7 @building_economy/house.webp@

@resource/rally.webp@1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to a 2nd @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and chop an additional 25 @resource/resource_wood.webp@. Then @resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_food.webp@
Gather 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ from @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ then switch to @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@. @resource/rally.webp@ until 12 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Add a few to gold and start producing more @resource/cattle.webp@ & @unit_malians/sofa-2.webp@
@building_military/archery-range.webp@ and 10 ish archers to protect sofas from spears. Now can also move on deer if map control.
Full @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ @unit_malians/sofa-2.webp@. Take @resource/relics.webp@ and play the game out with heavy raiding and expansion.

description: Cow boom but with infantry defence against aggro Civs like JD, French or English
name: Malian Cow Boom / fast Castle against aggro Civs
author: Nobu

notes: 1@https://age4builder.com/img/villagerMA.webp@ to build @building_malians/pit-mine-1.png@ + 6@https://age4builder.com/img/house.png@ / 5 @https://age4builder.com/img/villagerMA.png@   to one straggler tree
When 150@https://age4builder.com/img/resourcewoodicon.webp@ take all 5@https://age4builder.com/img/villagerMA.png@ from straggler tree to @https://age4builder.com/img/sheep.png@
1@unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ starts building a @building_military/barracks.png@ for @unit_malians/donso-1.png@ against cav
NOTE: If the opponent makes early MAA just build some @unit_malians/musofadi-warrior-2.png@ to kill em

NOTE: If the opponent is passive suddenly, attack with @unit_malians/javelin-thrower-2.png@@unit_malians/warrior-scout-2.png@ and deny his @resource/resource_gold.png@@resource/resource_food.png@@resource/resource_wood.png@
Meanwhile build a @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ on your closest @resource/resource_wood.png@ with the @unit_worker/villager-malians.png@ that are on stragglers
1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.png@ builds a @building_economy/mill.png@ next to the @building_economy/town-center.png@
if @resource/sheep.webp@ runs out send @unit_worker/villager-malians.png@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@ if they idle
1@unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ builds another @building_economy/mill.png@ on the other side of the @building_economy/town-center.png@
Start building @resource/cattle.webp@ and keep up building @building_malians/cattle-ranch-2.png@ until 7
Build another @building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@ on the big @resource/resource_gold.png@ if the opponent is passive
Keep producing @unit_malians/sofa-2.png@ and a few more @unit_malians/warrior-scout-2.png@ ATTACK and control the game

description: Simple malian build order made by ChillyEmpire. Modified for season 9 changes.
name: Malians Basic BO - ChillyEmpire
author: Skill

notes: Aim for 10 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@on @resource/sheep.png@, then rally to another @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@

All @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@but 4 from @resource/sheep.png@, go to @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@@resource/resource_wood.png@ (or @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ if not enough wood, then @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@)
Build 2 @building_economy/mill.webp@ (1 next to TC, one next to berries) and 6 @building_malians/cattle-ranch-2.png@ around a blank 4x4 area.
Constantly produce @resource/cattle.png@, until you fill all the @building_malians/cattle-ranch-2.png@(18 in total).
Mass produce @unit_malians/sofa-2.webp@ and @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@. Build a @building_religious/mosque.png@, and start getting  @resource/relics.png@
You should also build another @building_malians/pit-mine-1.png@at this point.

description: Transcribed version of Vortix's build order that consists of harassing with a few Warriors Scouts and Sofas, while producing Archers to defend, and build a Cow Boom behind it. That way you delay the opponent while having your Castle composition ready to be upgraded.
name: Vortix's Feudal Aggro with Sofas into Cow Boom
author: Eldritch

notes: Send 5 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to collect 1 full @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and then send back to @resource/sheep.webp@ until age-up
Send 1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to build @building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@ and then 6 @building_economy/house.webp@ around it, then back to @resource/sheep.webp@ until age-up
Build @landmark_malians/mansa-quarry-2.webp@ with 4 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ in front of your base
Build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ with the next @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ from @building_economy/town-center.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 8
@resource/rally.webp@ 1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and build @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ and leave them to mine
@resource/rally.webp@ 1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@ and build @building_economy/mill.webp@ and leave them to gather

Send 3 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ from @landmark_malians/mansa-quarry-2.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ and 1 to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to have 8 on @resource/resource_food.webp@ in total with the @resource/berrybush.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ once you have 10 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ including the 2 building the @building_military/stable.webp@
Once @building_economy/mill.webp@ is built, produce 3 @resource/cattle.webp@ and send them where you'll build your first @building_malians/cattle-ranch-2.webp@
When @building_military/stable.webp@ is built, research @unit_malians/warrior-scout-2.webp@ Veteran upgrade and then queue 1 @unit_malians/warrior-scout-2.webp@  and start harassing the opponent
If safe to do so, build a second @building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@ and @building_economy/house.webp@
If unsafe, build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and make @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ first to secure the location if possible
Build a second @building_economy/mill.webp@ to produce @resource/cattle.webp@ while @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ researches in the other one
Produce @unit_malians/sofa-2.webp@ as soon as possible to continue harassing the opponent, and keep producing them
Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ whenever possible to defend and start making @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 8 and research @technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@, then @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@

at 8 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-malians.png@ send one to build @building_economy/house.png@ and 2nd @building_malians/pit-mine-1.png@ when @age/age_2.png@. Finish the @building_economy/house.png@ring

1 @resource/resource_wood.png@ @unit_worker/villager-malians.png@ @abilities/repair.png@ @building_economy/mining-camp.png@ and @building_economy/house.png@ at 1st @building_malians/pit-mine-1.png@ to complete the ring

Make 3 more gradually @unit_malians/warrior-scout-2.webp@ to harass & self-heal
Research@technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@,@technology_economy/horticulture.webp@. Move on @resource/deer.webp@ if map control present.
Your  @building_malians/pit-mine-1.webp@ Should be Gathering {81}@resource/resource_gold.png@ Per Min

Make @building_economy/mill.png@ Close to TC for better @resource/cattle.png@ Production
